tasks.prompt: Summarise who renews or rotates each kind of certificate in a kubeadm cluster, including the cases where kubeadm will not do it for you.

rubric.text: Leaf certificates expire after 1 year and are renewed by kubeadm upgrade (automatically, if upgrades are less than 1 year apart) or by kubeadm certs renew
kubeadm does not rotate CA certificates; automation is undecided, so rotate or replace them manually well before the 10-year validity ends
The kubelet client certificate is rotated by the kubelet, except when ca.key was removed (external CA mode), where you must regenerate, sign and embed it yourself
Certificates signed by an external CA are not managed by kubeadm; the operator renews them

tasks.notes: cross-section: renewal table, automatic renewal, CA rotation, kubelet.conf considerations.
tasks.author: ai-task-writer-i

tasks.prompt: Explain the steps and caveats of renewing kubeadm certificates manually on an HA cluster.

rubric.text: Run kubeadm certs renew on every control plane node
Renewal takes attributes from the existing certificates, not from the kubeadm-config ConfigMap (keep them in sync anyway)
Restart the control plane Pods afterwards because dynamic reload is not supported for all components; for static Pods move the manifest out, wait about 20 seconds, then move it back
The --use-api flag is gone; renewing through the certificates API means setting up a signer and creating the CSR yourself

tasks.notes: cross-section: manual renewal plus Changes to this page.
